'And recognizing the grace that I had been given, James, Cephas, and John-those reputed to be pillars-gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship' (Gal 2:9). **Paul names him as a pillar** -- one of very few places outside the gospels and Acts that place him at all. Paul does not name himself in the verse -- he writes 'me and Barnabas' -- so the pair rides on the letter's own opening.
